scenario_name: 入門：一台機組主軸承磨耗，額定風速

cases.root_cause: 主軸承 1（PLC 事件 262 / 240 監測的軸承）潤滑劣化、磨耗：摩擦生熱隨轉速增加且散熱變差，軸承溫度與機艙振動、峰度逐步上升，越過 85 °C 警報、95 °C 跳機；共用潤滑與傳熱，軸承溫度 2 也跟著升溫（幅度約三成）。
cases.root_cause_en: Main bearing 1 (monitored by PLC events 262 / 240) lubrication degradation and wear: friction heat rises with speed while heat removal worsens, so bearing temperature, nacelle vibration and kurtosis climb past the 85 °C alarm and 95 °C trip setpoints; through shared lubrication and heat conduction bearing temperature 2 rises too (by about a third as much).

manual_refs.cause: Main bearing temperature 1 is high and might culminate into a trip
manual_refs.rectification: Check lubrication main bearing. Check cooling fan.
Check lubrication main bearing. Check cooling fan.

expected_actions: 檢查主軸承潤滑（油脂量 / 油質）（手冊）
檢查軸承冷卻風扇（手冊）
比對振動頻譜（峰度、高頻帶）評估軸承損傷，必要時安排更換
expected_actions_en: Review vibration spectra (kurtosis, high-frequency band) for bearing damage; plan replacement if needed.
simulation_notes: 模擬的量測 tag 是 WGEN_GnBrgTmp1（發電機軸承溫度），PLC 以它判定事件 262 / 240（Main bearing 1）；情境名稱沿用 Generator Bearing Wear。
simulation_notes_en: The simulated measurement tag is WGEN_GnBrgTmp1 (generator bearing temperature); the PLC uses it for events 262 / 240 (Main bearing 1). The scenario keeps its legacy name Generator Bearing Wear.
